description.value:
Duration constant

Bio-augments installed in your own body no longer count their Resonance toward whatever total or threshold triggers a Bloom for you — your own grafts have gone fully symbiotic with your Blooming flesh instead of fighting it. Your Resonance total is otherwise unchanged: it still rises normally, still feeds the Resonance bands, and still needs the §5 rite to bring down.

cinderfall.incomplete: This card's entire payload is a Vitae-spend/gain beyond the bare pool, a Bloom Table roll/choice, Resonance, Load, Strain, or "Mk" grade -- none of which has any rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus. fleshmancer.vitae-pool.json's own SpecialResource (slug: vitae, max: 10, renew: false) only declares the bare pool; its schema (value, max, itemUUID, level, renew) has no field for a per-source gain/spend/reroll/choose trigger, so every Vitae-cost/-gain clause on every other card is inert as far as system.rules is concerned, and Bloom/Resonance/Load/Strain have no representation at all. Specifically, Resonance and Bloom thresholds have no rule-element representation to exempt this actor's own bio-augments from.
